_meta.description: Golden supplier rankings per (category,corridor) for the offline ranking eval (NDCG@k / MRR / precision@k). ideal_order + graded relevance are the accepted ordering; the eval scores engine output against these.
_meta.verified_cases_note: Top-level 'verified' covers the three Romain-endorsed cases above; the 4th case (movers/SG-SG domestic) is per-case attribute_derived (see its _meta_case_status), not yet human-endorsed.
_meta.note: Independent gold derived from supplier attributes, NOT copied from engine output (see audit/admin/36-ranking-gold-worksheet.md). Romain endorsed the central judgments on 2026-07-01: Banks — branch_need=medium demotes pure-digital banks (Wise/Revolut), Citibank (b-4) is the top pick; Insurance — expat_specialized tier separates Cigna/Allianz/Bupa/GeoBlue from generalists; Movers (international SG→Tokyo) — exact-city match priority, non-international movers hard-floored to grade 0. No ideal_order or relevance grades were changed during promotion. Case 4 (movers SG-SG domestic) is attribute_derived / deferred: local SG specialists (m-3/m-7/m-10) grade 3 because domestic move does NOT justify high-cost international movers; hard-floor does NOT apply (move_type=domestic).

cases._meta_case_note: Domestic path — hard-floor does NOT apply (move_type=domestic). Local SG specialists (m-3/m-7/m-10) grade 3: exact-fit or ample capacity, low-to-medium cost, high availability. m-5 grade 2 (slightly under capacity, 12m3 vs 15m3 est). Medium-cost international movers (m-8/m-6) grade 2: capable but overkill. High-cost international (m-1/m-2) grade 1. High-cost+low-availability (m-9/m-4) grade 0. Grades derived from supplier attributes independently; NOT copied from engine output.
